- [ov.analysis.arch.rendering](_autosummary/ov.analysis.arch.rendering.html.md): Rendering-model classifier: CSR vs SSR/SSG via raw-HTML-vs-rendered-DOM diff (D2).
- [ov.analysis.arch.sidecar](_autosummary/ov.analysis.arch.sidecar.html.md): Python facade over the Node reverse-engineering sidecar (§6.1, D2).
- [ov.analysis.arch.sourcemaps](_autosummary/ov.analysis.arch.sourcemaps.html.md): Pure source-map recovery: original file tree + &#96;node_modules&#96; versions (D2).
- [ov.analysis.context](_autosummary/ov.analysis.context.html.md): The analysis context + analyzer output – the currency of the pure analyzers.
- [ov.analysis.diff](_autosummary/ov.analysis.diff.html.md): Own-target diffing: a run vs a stored prior baseline run (review mode, §10).
- [ov.analysis.evidence](_autosummary/ov.analysis.evidence.html.md): The evidence-bundle assembler (§8.1, D4) – deterministic, model-free.
- [ov.analysis.reliability](_autosummary/ov.analysis.reliability.html.md): Reliability passes over findings (§5.2, D4) – deterministic gates, model-free.
- [ov.analysis.run](_autosummary/ov.analysis.run.html.md): The analysis orchestrator – resolve, order, run analyzers, merge into the run.
- [ov.analysis.ux](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.html.md): UX + accessibility deterministic analyzers (§5.1, D3).
- [ov.analysis.ux.a11y](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.a11y.html.md): Accessibility analyzer: WebAIM perennials from the DOM + optional axe mapping.
- [ov.analysis.ux.contrast_focus](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.contrast_focus.html.md): Contrast + focus analyzer (deterministic, no engine).
- [ov.analysis.ux.cwv](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.cwv.html.md): Core Web Vitals analyzer: performance-as-UX from the captured &#96;perf&#96; artifacts.
- [ov.analysis.ux.forms](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.forms.html.md): Form-records analyzer: the state-changing actions a page offers, and what guards them (#21).
- [ov.analysis.ux.heuristics](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.heuristics.html.md): Heuristic analyzer: the automatable subset of Nielsen / cognitive-walkthrough (D3 §6).
- [ov.analysis.ux.metrics](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.metrics.html.md): Journey-metrics analyzer: form friction, backtracking, and journey summary (D3 §5).
- [ov.analysis.ux.severity](_autosummary/ov.analysis.ux.severity.html.md): Severity scoring: &#96;score = impact_tier x reach&#96; (D3 §1).
- [ov.base](_autosummary/ov.base.html.md): Single source of truth (SSOT) for the &#96;ov&#96; artifact schema.
- [ov.capture](_autosummary/ov.capture.html.md): Capture layer: drive a browser and record behavioral + static streams.
- [ov.capture.browser](_autosummary/ov.capture.browser.html.md): Playwright facade – the baseline driver (§9, D1).
- [ov.capture.cdp](_autosummary/ov.capture.cdp.html.md): The CDP escape-hatch plugin (Chromium-only) – the ~20% Playwright can’t reach.
- [ov.capture.probes](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.html.md): Probes – the registerable units of &#42;what intelligence to gather&#42; (§2).
- [ov.capture.probes.a11y](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.a11y.html.md): Accessibility-signals probe: computed text styles (for contrast) + optional axe.
- [ov.capture.probes.assets](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.assets.html.md): Assets probe: a content-addressed inventory of loaded resources.
- [ov.capture.probes.console](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.console.html.md): Console probe: console messages, page errors, and unhandled rejections.
- [ov.capture.probes.dom](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.dom.html.md): DOM probe: serialized DOM + ARIA snapshot (agent view) + full AX tree (evidence).
- [ov.capture.probes.fingerprint](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.fingerprint.html.md): Fingerprint probe: a built-in, license-clean technology detector.
- [ov.capture.probes.navigation](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.navigation.html.md): Navigation probe: URL changes, redirects, frame tree, and SPA history.
- [ov.capture.probes.network](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.network.html.md): Network probe: request/response metadata + bodies, accumulated from events.
- [ov.capture.probes.perf](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.perf.html.md): Performance probe: Navigation Timing, paint, web-vitals entries, CDP counters.
- [ov.capture.probes.screenshot](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.screenshot.html.md): Screenshot probe: full-page PNG per captured state.
- [ov.capture.probes.sse](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.sse.html.md): SSE probe: Server-Sent-Event frames via CDP (Chromium-only).
- [ov.capture.probes.storage](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.storage.html.md): Storage probe: cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB names.
- [ov.capture.probes.websocket](_autosummary/ov.capture.probes.websocket.html.md): WebSocket probe: frames sent/received and open/close, first-class (D1).
- [ov.capture.session](_autosummary/ov.capture.session.html.md): &#96;CaptureSession&#96; – owns the browser and orchestrates the probes (§3.1).
- [ov.capture.stores](_autosummary/ov.capture.stores.html.md): The capture store – a &#96;MutableMapping&#96; Mall over a run directory (§3.4).
- [ov.config](_autosummary/ov.config.html.md): Configuration – the single source of truth for &#96;ov&#96;’s defaults.
- [ov.operate](_autosummary/ov.operate.html.md): The operate layer – deterministic, LLM-free tool primitives (the “hands”).
- [ov.operate.driver](_autosummary/ov.operate.driver.html.md): The scripted/guided driver – model-free journey execution (Phase 1).
- [ov.operate.perception](_autosummary/ov.operate.perception.html.md): Perception strategies – pluggable ways to turn a page into an &#96;Observation&#96;.
- [ov.operate.strategies](_autosummary/ov.operate.strategies.html.md): Journey-strategy helpers – intent shaping for the three strategies (§2.3).
- [ov.registry](_autosummary/ov.registry.html.md): The plugin mechanism: decorated functions registered into a dict (§3.2).
- [ov.reporting](_autosummary/ov.reporting.html.md): Report layer: registered Markdown sections + the synopsis (Phase 2).
- [ov.reporting.overview](_autosummary/ov.reporting.overview.html.md): The &#96;overview&#96; one-liner: observe -&gt; analyze -&gt; report -&gt; synopsis (§4).
- [ov.reporting.render](_autosummary/ov.reporting.render.html.md): Render Markdown report sections from an analyzed run (§8.3).
- [ov.reporting.sections](_autosummary/ov.reporting.sections.html.md): The default report sections (§8.3) – each a registered Markdown fragment.
- [ov.reporting.synopsis](_autosummary/ov.reporting.synopsis.html.md): Synopsis: structured map-reduce over findings into one agent-consumable file (§8.4).
- [ov.util](_autosummary/ov.util.html.md): Internal helpers: content-addressing, hashing, redaction, and requirements.
